Name: Junimos Accept Cash
Author: spacechase0
Description:
[b]Junimos Accept Cash[/b] lets you purchase community center bundles with gold.

[b][size=5]Install[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[b][size=5]Use[/size][/b]
Click the purchase button above the bundle icon in the community center UI to complete the bundle.The price changes based on the most expensive items left in the bundle.

[b][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/b]
Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.5.5+ on Linux/macOS/Windows, both single-player and multiplayer.
